summary: Verified Emergent Google Sign-In backend + frontend flow. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass (POST /api/auth/session invalid→401 with 'Failed to validate session', missing body→422; dev-login end-to-end, /auth/me no-auth→401, /auth/me bogus token→401, logout invalidates token; regression /api/jobs, /api/subscription/status, /api/consent/list all reachable with dev token). Frontend: /login renders SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE button (testID login-google-btn); button is aria-disabled=true until disclaimer is scrolled AND checkbox is checked; on click it performs full-page redirect to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>/ (verified via captured request + subsequent hop to accounts.google.com). Dev-login CONTINUE flow signs the user in and lands on the /(tabs) dashboard with 4 seeded jobs and tab bar (Jobs/Diagnose/Estimate/Safety/Settings). No red screens or blocking errors.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: various components using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius.
Console warning: 'useNativeDriver is not supported' — expected on web preview; verify no perf/UX issue on native builds.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Likely from a third-party or internal component.

action_items: (Optional/low priority) Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' RN style props to 'boxShadow' across the app to silence RN 0.76+ warnings.
(Optional/low priority) Replace `props.pointerEvents` with `style.pointerEvents` in RN components using the legacy prop.
(Pre-existing note, unchanged from iteration_1) /api/auth/dev-login is always-on; gate behind ALLOW_DEV_LOGIN env before shipping to production.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1550 lines — should be split into routers (auth, jobs, ai, voice, billing, consent, public) before further growth.
FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated; migrate to the lifespan context manager.

POST /api/auth/session correctly follows the Emergent playbook (X-Session-ID → session-data → mint own 7-day token) and never re-verifies a session_token. Login.tsx correctly uses full-page redirect on web and openAuthSessionAsync on native. Apple flow correctly calls installSession() directly with the backend-minted token instead of re-exchanging via /auth/session (bug fix verified in code).
